# Install

Two ways to use it, same set of files. §3 (dependencies) and §4 (smoke test) apply to both.

## 1. As a TCH repo skill (default)

The skill lives in `.agents/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme/` (source); `.claude/skills/` is a **symlink mirror**
generated by `pnpm skills:sync` — do not copy by hand. The name is already in `.agents/skills/public-skills.txt` (13/09).

```bash
pnpm skills:sync      # rebuild the mirror
pnpm skills:check     # part of pnpm build:check: the mirror must be symlinks, matching the whitelist
test -L .claude/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme && echo OK
```

Claude Code loads the skill from `SKILL.md` (frontmatter `name`, `description`). In TCH there is no
`.claude-plugin/` for this skill — Lee settled on 13/09 not to release it outside the repo.

## 2. As a standalone folder (Codex, Cursor, other agents)

```bash
ln -s "$(pwd)/.agents/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme" ~/.claude/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme   # Claude Code outside the repo
ln -s "$(pwd)/.agents/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme/AGENTS.md" /path/to/workdir/AGENTS.md       # Codex/Cursor
```

The symlink keeps the skill live with the repo; remove it by `rm` on **the link** (no trailing `/`). For any other tool:
[`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) is the entry point; it points to `SKILL.md` and then to each phase's packet; scripts run with
plain `node`.

Note: `scripts/ingest/spec-pack.mjs` compares the **realpath** to detect "run directly", so running through a
symlink still works (the T4 version once broke at exactly this spot — `--validate` exited 0 without printing anything).

## 3. Dependencies

### Node ≥ 22.19 or ≥ 24 (required)

Same rule as the repo (`CLAUDE.md` §5). Measured 13/09: `v24.11.1`.

```bash
cd .agents/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme
npm install                       # jsdom (parse) + playwright (render, scanner)
npx playwright install chromium   # binary for scripts/review/* and scripts/shoot.mjs
npm test                          # node --test scripts/test/*.test.mjs
```

With a symlink install, `node_modules/` lives in the repo and is shared — install once. **Do not run `pnpm`
in the skill folder**: it is not a workspace member (its own `package.json`, `private`).

### Docker (Phase 0, 7–10)

Docker runs **locally on the iMac** (root `CLAUDE.md`). Fleet images: `wordpress:apache` (latest core,
7.1 when measured), `mariadb:11`, `wordpress:cli`. Sample stand — `~/TracyHQ/quickstart-builds/tracy-base-wp7-1.0.0/compose.yml`:

```yaml
name: tracy-base-wp7
services:
  db:
    image: mariadb:11
    environment: { MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD}, MARIADB_DATABASE: wp }
    volumes: [db:/var/lib/mysql]
  web:
    image: wordpress:apache
    depends_on: [db]
    ports: ["127.0.0.1:8227:80"]
    environment: &wpenv
      WORDPRESS_DB_HOST: db
      WORDPRESS_DB_USER: root
      WORDPRESS_DB_PASSWORD: ${MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      WORDPRESS_DB_NAME: wp
      WORDPRESS_TABLE_PREFIX: tr_
      WORDPRESS_DEBUG: "1"
      WORDPRESS_CONFIG_EXTRA: |
        define('WP_DEBUG_LOG', true);
        define('WP_DEBUG_DISPLAY', false);
    volumes: [./capture:/var/www/html]
  cli:
    image: wordpress:cli
    entrypoint: ["wp"]            # the image does not add `wp` by itself — gotchas #2
    depends_on: [db, web]
    user: "33:33"
    environment: *wpenv
    volumes: [./capture:/var/www/html, ./dist:/dist:ro]
volumes: { db: {} }
networks:
  default: { ipam: { config: [{ subnet: 10.89.2.0/24 }] } }
```

```bash
docker compose -p tracy-base-wp7 up -d                                    # ALWAYS -p: the project name owns the network + volume
docker compose -p tracy-base-wp7 run --rm cli core version                # 7.1
docker compose -p tracy-base-wp7 run --rm cli theme install /dist/tracy-base.zip --force --activate
```

Check that `docker network ls` has no overlapping subnet before `up`; check `df -h /` before a heavy run (Docker
dies silently when the disk is full — gotchas #4).

### Browser for live renders

`scripts/shoot.mjs` and `scripts/review/*` use the skill's headless Playwright Chromium — no MCP needed.
When Lee needs to look, open the link in real Chrome (`open <url>`), do not take a screenshot instead.

## 4. Confirm it runs (smoke test on the bundled fixture)

```bash
cd .agents/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme
npm test
node scripts/ingest/from-joomla.mjs scripts/test/fixtures/joomla-min --out /tmp/x --page-floor 6
node scripts/ingest/spec-pack.mjs --validate /tmp/x --page-floor 6
```

Expected (measured 13/09/2026):

```
from-joomla: 5 routes → 6 pages (3 WordPress pages, 1 gaps) · 1 posts · 2 categories · 2 menus · 2 ACM sections (+1 custom modules) · 1 redirects
  note: synthetic pages added for required views with no route: single.html, 404.html
  …
spec-pack OK — 6 pages, kind=url, adapter=from-joomla
spec-pack OK — 6 pages, kind=url, 6 reference target(s) checked, adapter=from-joomla
```

`--page-floor 6` is needed: the fixture has 6 pages, the default floor is 12 — without the flag both commands exit 1 with
exactly one "coverage floor" error, and that is the gate doing its job, not a bug. `npm test` expects `ℹ fail 0` (the test
count is measured with `node scripts/check-docs-numbers.mjs`, not hard-coded here); one test skipped outside TCH is intended
(TCH's IMPORT-NOTE says why).

The **onto-a-stand** path (seed, then curl 200) is not in the smoke test because it needs Docker: run
`node scripts/seed.mjs --spec /tmp/x --wp "<runner>" --theme <slug> --patterns-map … --images … --dry-run`
to see the plan, then drop `--dry-run` on a real stand (INSTALL §3).
